newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S.Australia to review Cooper Basin gas legislation.
newsitem.headline: S.Australia to review Cooper Basin gas legislation.

text.p: South Australian legislation underpinning the development of gas resources in the Cooper Basin by Santos Ltd and its production partners is to be reviewed, the state government said on Tuesday.

Energy Minister Stephen Baker said in a statement the review would examine how the legislation - the Cooper Basin (Ratification) Act 1975 and Indenture Agreement - might affect competition and whether it could be a barrier to free trade between the states.
The review is to be undertaken by South Australian consultant Nick Dyki and conformed to followed the competition principles agreement of the Council of Australian Governments (COAG), he said.
Public submissions were being invited and the review was expected to be completed by September 1997, he said.

Santos partners in the Cooper Basin include Boral Ltd unit Boral Energy Resources, Crusader Resources, a unit of Clyde Petroleum Plc and Delhi Petroleum, a unit of Exxon Corp. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
